digest.component_or_area: snapshot store janitor and garbage collection
propositions: The snapshot janitor's 2 GiB absolute free-space watermark is disk-size-blind and unreachable on a 30 GiB root (only crossed at 93.3% used, above the 85% alarm floor and 90% observed peak).

Review-bot's per-review snapshot materialization writes ~620 MiB full copies of the 69,984-file ticket tree on the container writable layer (root disk) because REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR is unset and store_root() falls through to tempfile.gettempdir().

The janitor's 7-day cold-trim trigger exceeds the container lifetime (23 recreations in 4 days) and the promised byte-total backstop is not implemented in _gc_pass, leaving only the absolute watermark as an active eviction trigger.
Reclaim now engages when free space falls below the larger of an absolute floor or a volume-relative percentage, with hysteresis to overshoot the trigger and prevent re-firing every 300 seconds.
The new knob defaults to 0 (off) for backward compatibility; review-bot opts in at 20% headroom via REBAR_GATE_FREE_WATERMARK_PCT=20 in compose, matching autodeploy's DISK_PRESSURE_PCT=80.

The fix bounds the store via reclaim thresholds but does not address the dominant cause (RC-A: the ~620 MiB-per-review ticket-tree copy on a cache key with no reuse), which remains in smart-disloyal-naga.
